qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unreplicable aged cognac (Martell), Scotch whisky (Chivas Regal, The Glenlivet), and Irish whiskey (Jameson) maturation inventories tied to statutory protected regions and centuries-old distillation terroir. Tangible operating ROIC exceeds 20% on physical operating capital, with demonstrated pricing power through positive price/mix realization across the business cycle.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. World #2 premium spirits group anchored by protected-origin aged cognac, Scotch, and Irish whiskey inventories. Tangible operating ROIC >20% on physical capital with multi-cycle pricing power. Net debt/EBITDA ~3.1x and interest coverage >6.5x provide peace-of-mind solvency through industry downturns. [5-10Y g: global volume 1.0% + premium price 2.0% + aged mix 1.5% - China tariff drag 0.5% + net buyback/deleveraging 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: Tangible ROIC >20% (Recurring operating profit ~€3.3B on ~€13B PPE and operating working capital, though GAAP ROIC is 6-8% due to €18B accounting goodwill from Allied Domecq/Absolut). Multi-year FCF conversion ~80%. Net debt of €6.34B represents ~3.1x EBITDA with EBIT/interest coverage of 6.7x. Divestment of lower-margin wine brands refocuses capital on high-margin spirits.
